problem_context.problem_statement: Reverify CircularAreaReset after adopting the idmanager-style unified store_circular_area resource. The public function contract must expose only one circular_area_state and must not expose backing buffer, indices, status, physical option bytes, operations pointer, or GlobalStrings. Reset preserves capacity and descriptor ownership and changes only the abstract FIFO contents to nil.
problem_context.expected_behavior: For every valid store_circular_area state, write writeidx=0, readidx=0, b_status=0; preserve capacity, backing allocation, physical option-byte contents, descriptor identity and hidden operations pointer; return store_circular_area (Build_circular_area_state (ca_capacity state) nil) circular_area.
problem_context.input_output_contract: Pre: store_circular_area state circular_area. Post: store_circular_area (Build_circular_area_state (ca_capacity state) nil) circular_area. Use one public With state only. Implementation-level existential values may be opened internally by symbolic execution but must not appear in the public contract.
spec_hint: Prefer direct Build_circular_area_state (ca_capacity state) nil in the postcondition so the shared common library remains unchanged after Init. Add only the Extern Coq declarations needed for circular_area_state, ca_capacity, Build_circular_area_state, and store_circular_area.
preferred_hidden_properties: Init output and every later API using store_circular_area can call Reset directly without mixed/full conversion or caller-visible representation witnesses.

annotation_design_summary.anti_algorithm_mirror_review: passed; no Rocq algorithm/state-machine definition was added
hidden_properties: Backing allocation, descriptor identity, p_head, p_tail, area_length, operations pointer, and physical option bytes are preserved inside store_circular_area.
Only writeidx, readidx, and b_status are overwritten with zero.
No GlobalStrings resource is exposed or required.
annotation_design_summary.internal_representation_opening: A single full Assert existentially opens only descriptor/backing resources and the minimal capacity/physical-length facts needed to execute the writes and reconstruct store_circular_area.
annotation_design_summary.mathematical_effect: Preserve ca_capacity and reset FIFO contents to nil.
annotation_design_summary.public_contract: With (state : circular_area_state); Require store_circular_area state circular_area; Ensure store_circular_area (Build_circular_area_state (ca_capacity state) nil) circular_area
